title: Tenant region bindings and compliance ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Provide a first-class mechanism for pinning a tenant (or tenant subset) to one or more geographic regions for Hosted API traffic, plus an immutable compliance ledger that produces attestable evidence bundles for audits. Unlike simple geo-preference toggles, this feature exposes explicit tenant->region bindings, retention/TTL controls, and a signed periodic snapshot that can be exported to customers and internal compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create and edit Tenant Region Bindings via Console and API with validation and audit metadata
Bindings are enforced by routing layer: requests for a bound tenant prefer pinned regions and fall back only according to policy
Compliance ledger generates daily signed snapshots that include binding state, retention policies, and routing events; snapshots are downloadable and verifiable
Retention settings for residency evidence are configurable per-tenant and applied automatically to evidence bundles
End-to-end telemetry surfaces binding violations, fallback events, and evidence bundle generation success/failure in Console dashboards
Security review completed and KMS/HSM signing integration validated (no plaintext keys in logs)
requirements: Console: new Tenant > Residency panel to declare region bindings and retention TTL
API: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/residency to create/update binding, GET to fetch current asserted regions
Routing: routing decision accepts tenant-binding header and routes accordingly; policy DSL supports hard/soft binds
Ledger: immutable, append-only snapshot store with cryptographic signature using KMS; snapshots stored in S3 with retention lifecycle
Evidence export: single-click export (zip) containing manifest.json, binding-delta log, routing-event sample, and signature
Metrics: counters for binding changes, enforcement rate, fallback count, snapshot generation latency/errors
console_changes: Residency panel mockups reviewed by design (see design critique notes)
Add 'Residency' section on Tenant settings with: Region selector, Binding mode (Hard | Soft), Retention TTL input, Export evidence button
Integrate evidence export UX with progress-toaster and link to generated artifact in Activity stream
api_changes: Introduce new endpoints under /v1/tenants to manage residency bindings
Ensure API responses include effective_region and fallback_policy in tenant metadata
Audit log entries emitted for create/update/delete including actor and request_id
backend_changes: Routing layer: accept tenant residency assertions and mark priority regions accordingly
Snapshot processor: daily job that reads tenant bindings, composes manifest, signs via KMS, uploads to evidence bucket
Retention orchestrator: apply TTL to evidence objects and enforce per-tenant retention settings
Store binding changes in immutable ledger table (append-only) with sequencing and transaction id
telemetry_and_evidence: New dashboards: Residency overview, Enforcement health, Evidence generation pipeline
Alert when enforcement rate < 99.5% for a tenant group or when snapshot job fails more than 3 times in 24h
Evidence bundle format: manifest.json (schema v1), bindings.ndjson (append-only deltas), routing-events.ndjson (sampled), signature.sig (kms-signed SHA256)
rollout_plan: Alpha: feature flags off by default; enable for internal tenants and compliance team only
Beta: enable opt-in for selected customers with active contracts; collect telemetry and usability feedback
GA: default available in Console + API; migration guide for customers who previously used geo-preferences
Backstop: soft-failover policy at routing layer to avoid availability regressions during GA
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect routing could increase latency for bound tenants — Mitigation: deploy canary and synthetic latency checks per region
Risk: Evidence snapshot missing events — Mitigation: add end-to-end integrity tests and reconcile ledger sequence numbers nightly
Risk: Keys compromised — Mitigation: KMS/HSM signing only; rotate keys and maintain key usage audit logs
Risk: Customer confusion over Hard vs Soft binds — Mitigation: explanatory copy in Console and guided migration flow
testing_and_validation: Unit & integration tests for API and ledger writers
E2E routing test harness simulating tenant traffic with pinned regions and measuring enforcement
Acceptance test that verifies signature on evidence bundle can be verified with public key
Manual UX validation sessions with two customers in Beta cohort
